set.body:
Purpose:
Decide whether a portable effectful store algebra earns a lasting place after the JVM loader pilot.

Scope:
- Compare the direct JVM loader against a minimal BidsStore[F] algebra for listing entries, reading UTF-8 metadata/tables, and obtaining stable entry metadata.
- If piloted, provide only the minimum in-memory interpreter and JVM Path interpreter needed to test portability and deterministic failure injection.
- Keep BIDS parsing/validation pure above the interpreter and keep platform paths/Throwable values out of shared data.
- Do not implement S3, HTTP, browser File System Access, Zarr, caching, retry, or streaming in this slice.
- Measure whether the seam materially improves tests, removes duplicated IO logic, or enables an already-planned consumer.
- Record keep, narrow, or remove; remove the abstraction if the direct loader is clearer and sufficient.

Acceptance:
- The decision is supported by concrete API/diff/test evidence, not general tagless-final preference.
- A kept seam has at least two interpreters, deterministic tests, and no hidden runtime execution.
- A rejected seam leaves no dead abstraction or dependency residue.
- Shared/JVM/Scala.js placement follows the module boundary contract.
set.title: BIDS F5: decide the portable BidsStore effect seam
